List Group

List groups are a flexible and powerful component for displaying a series of content. They support links, buttons, badges, contextual states, and even rich custom content.

Basic List Group

Use .zak-list-group with .zak-list-item children.

  • Dapibus ac facilisis in
  • Morbi leo risus
  • Porta ac consectetur ac
  • Vestibulum at eros
HTML
<ul class="zak-list-group">
  <li class="zak-list-item">Dapibus ac facilisis in</li>
  <li class="zak-list-item">Morbi leo risus</li>
  <li class="zak-list-item">Porta ac consectetur ac</li>
</ul>

List Group with Links

Swap list items for links to make the whole row clickable.

Cras justo odio Porta ac consectetur ac Vestibulum at eros
HTML
<div class="zak-list-group">
  <a href="#" class="zak-list-item">Cras justo odio</a>
  <a href="#" class="zak-list-item">Porta ac consectetur ac</a>
</div>

List Group with Buttons

Use <button> elements when you need click behavior without navigation.

HTML
<div class="zak-list-group">
  <button type="button" class="zak-list-item">Cras justo odio</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-list-item">Dapibus ac facilisis in</button>
</div>

List Group with Badges

Add badges on the trailing edge for counts.

  • Cras justo odio14
  • Dapibus ac facilisis2
  • Morbi leo risus1
HTML
<ul class="zak-list-group">
  <li class="zak-list-item">
    <span>Cras justo odio</span>
    <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-primary" style="margin-left: auto;">14</span>
  </li>
</ul>

Horizontal List Group

Wrap items in a horizontal flex container with per-item gap overrides.

Left Middle Right
HTML
<div class="zak-list-group" style="flex-direction: row;">
  <a href="#" class="zak-list-item">Left</a>
  <a href="#" class="zak-list-item">Middle</a>
  <a href="#" class="zak-list-item">Right</a>
</div>

Flush List Group

Remove the outer border and rounding to make items sit flush inside a container.

  • Dapibus ac facilisis in
  • Morbi leo risus
  • Vestibulum at eros
HTML
<div class="zak-card">
  <ul class="zak-list-group">
    <li class="zak-list-item">Dapibus ac facilisis in</li>
  </ul>
</div>

Contextual Classes

Highlight active items with .zak-list-item-active or mute disabled items with .zak-list-item-disabled.

  • Cras justo odio14
  • Active item2
  • Morbi leo risus1
HTML
<ul class="zak-list-group">
  <li class="zak-list-item"><span>Cras justo odio</span></li>
  <li class="zak-list-item zak-list-item-active">Active item</li>
  <li class="zak-list-item zak-list-item-disabled">Disabled item</li>
</ul>

<!-- Status indicators on items -->
<li class="zak-list-item">
  <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-danger zak-badge-dot"></span> Unhealthy
</li>

Custom Content

Items are flexible rows — combine avatars, multi-line text and actions for richer content.

JA
Janet Fox
Product Designer
Online MK
Mark Kim
Frontend Engineer
Away SR
Sara Reyes
Data Analyst
Offline
HTML
<a href="#" class="zak-list-item">
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-sm zak-avatar-primary">JA</span>
  <div style="flex: 1;">
    <div style="font-weight: var(--zak-font-weight-semibold);">Janet Fox</div>
    <div style="font-size: var(--zak-font-size-xs); color: var(--zak-text-muted);">Product Designer</div>
  </div>
  <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-success">Online</span>
</a>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-list-groupVertical stack of bordered items with gaps
.zak-list-itemIndividual rounded, bordered row
.zak-list-item-activeActive/current item highlight
.zak-list-item-disabledDisabled, non-interactive item
.zak-badgeTrailing count/status badge (see Badge)

Accessibility

  • Use semantic list elements for non-interactive groups; switch to links/buttons for interactive rows.
  • Indicate the active item with aria-current="true" in addition to any visual highlight.
  • Disabled items should use aria-disabled="true" and remove any interactive handlers.
  • Interaction states must be visible on keyboard focus as well as on hover.
  • Ensure custom content inside an item does not create nested interactive elements.
